boundary.description: From the point where Rochdale – Oldham District boundary crosses Cinder Hill Lane near Cinder Hill Lane, S along Cinder Hill Lane to the bend in the road, and by a straight line to and SE along A627(M) Motorway, Chadderton Way (A627) to the rondabout. Then S along Featherstall Road South, Featherstall Road South, Manchester Street, Frederick Street, Hollins Road to M60 Motorway, junction 22. Then NW along the Motorway to junction 21 and then N by the Rochdale Canal and W along Middleton Road to and N along the railway and then by Rochdale – Oldham District boundary to the point where it crosses Cinder Hill Lane.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Herbert and Corpus Chisti
internalBoundaries.description: From the point on the Rochdale Canal opposite the junction of Moston Road and Grimshaw lane, and by a beeline E to the point where the railway crosses Featherstall Road South.
